post.summary: Set an account-wide daily billable ad-spend limit, with an optional exclusive end date. Creating or editing a daily limit requires an ad account on postpaid invoice billing. Omit end_date to retain an existing end, or send null for no end. First activation takes effect no earlier than the next account-local day. Increases and decreases apply on save and retain today's counted spend; a decrease below recorded spend is rejected. Like Date range limits, edits are not retroactive: delayed charges use the settings effective at their event time, and the spend check is not atomic with concurrent billing. The saved amount repeats each day in the recorded account timezone, without carryover, proration, or campaign-style flexibility. Use the latest configuration revision.
Remove the evergreen daily limit on save. Historical protected days and their billable allowances are retained for late events and corrections. Does not delete dated or IO limits.

Total value of attributed `order_created` events, normalized to the ad account currency. Negative event values are treated as zero. anyOf.description: Return on ad spend from attributed `order_created` events, calculated using the unrounded order-created attributed sales value divided by spend for the same insight row.
